_doc: Reward penalty weights and curriculum (rung) pass thresholds for the PoRace trainers. Read by training/reward_config.py (go2/joystick.py, matt/env.py incl. Grandma, eval.py) and mirrored by the Unreal DataAsset URaceRewardConfig (Source/PoRaceUnreal/RaceRewardConfig.h); tests/test_reward_config.py checks both. Weights are added to the per-step reward as weight * term (negative = penalty). torque_sq = sum(actuator force^2); joint_ang_vel_sq = sum(joint qvel^2); action_rate_sq = |a_t - a_{t-1}|^2; foot_slip = sum over feet in contact of |foot planar velocity|^2. The shipped brains predate this file (torque_sq and joint_ang_vel_sq were added 2026-11-20, and the humans' action_rate / foot_slip weights were 0 / stock pelvis-slip): they were NOT retrained.

curriculum.metric: pass fraction of seeded eval episodes: stand 10 s on a zero command
pass fraction: velocity tracking error < 0.2 m/s
pass fraction: 30 N.s push + 1 kg cube drop
pass fraction: standing within 3 s from fallen (getup)
pass fraction: forward speed >= 90 % of the command
pass fraction: 15 deg slope, straight + circling
pass fraction over 100 held-out episodes, zero NaN (graduation gate)
